.²1 [{#azwakaM#} ({#pARineH#}), {#vidanti aDIyate vA ityazwakAH sUtrAcca#}
 {#kopaDAt#} <ls>P. IV. 2. 65. Sk.</ls>] One who studies or is acquainted with the
 eight Adhyāyās of Pāṇiniʼs grammar.
.²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a son of Viśvāmitra (author of the hymn <ls>Rv. 10. 104.</ls>)

.²1 A collection of three days (7th, 8th, and 9th) beginning from the seventh
 day after the full moon.
.²2 The 8th day of three months on which the Manes are to be propitiated.
.²3 A Śrāddha to be performed on the above days; worship of the Manes
 on certain days; {#tasya vrAtasya yo'sya dvitIyo'pAnaH sAzwakA#} <ls>Av. 15. 16. 2</ls>;
 {#azwakApitfdEvatyamityayaM prasfto janaH#} <ls>Rām. 2. 108. 14</ls>.
.²4 The 8th day of a month; <ls>Ms. 4. 113-4</ls>.

a kind of board or cloth for playing with dice on
 (having eight divisions).
